What we deliver

Turn scan data into fully editable, manufacturable CAD.

We rebuild physical parts as parametric CAD models — for re-manufacturing legacy parts with no drawings, modifying existing designs, or creating moulds and tooling. You choose how faithful the model should be to the scanned part.

Design-intent modelling

A clean CAD model with manufacturing imperfections removed — ideal for re-manufacture from 3D models or 2D drawings.

NURBS surface models

Precise freeform surfaces fitted over scan data where an exact as-is representation matters.

Hybrid modelling

Prismatic features modelled to design intent, freeform areas surfaced to the scan — the best of both.

Drawings on request

2D manufacturing drawings with GD&T generated from the final model.

How we work

Scan to solution in four steps.

Step 01Capture

We scan the part, product or site — in our lab or on location.

Step 02Process

Scans are aligned, cleaned and merged into usable, watertight data.

Step 03Engineer

CAD, Class A surfaces, BIM or inspection built from that data.

Step 04Deliver

CAD files, drawings and reports in the formats your team uses.

05

Common questions

What do I need to send to get a quote?

Clear photos of the part from several angles, approximate dimensions, the quantity you plan to make, and what you need delivered (CAD only, CAD and drawings, or inspection). If you have an old drawing, even a partial one, send that too.

Can you reverse engineer a broken or worn part?

Yes. We scan what remains and rebuild the missing or worn geometry using design intent, symmetry, mating parts and any information you can share.

Will the new part be identical to the original?

It will match the original design intent and fit. Where wear has changed the shape, we restore the original geometry rather than copying the wear.
